subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Welding Robots: Sparks by the Million
description: A quick win: understand Welding Robots: Sparks by the Million.

hook.text: A car body has over 5,000 spot welds. Robots make every single one in under a minute per car.

buildup.text: Welding robots hold electrodes at precise positions. Electricity flows, metal melts, and two sheets fuse together.

discovery.text: Robots weld with perfect consistency. Every spot gets the same pressure, current, and timing. Quality never drifts.

twist.text: Arc welding robots handle continuous seams. They follow complex 3D paths while maintaining perfect torch angles.

climax.text: Today, over 50% of all industrial robots do welding. It was the killer application that proved robots worthwhile.

punchline.text: 5,000 perfect welds per car. No breaks, no mistakes.

quiz.question: Why did welding become the dominant application for industrial robots?
options: Welding is the simplest task for a robot to perform accurately
Robots deliver perfect consistency in pressure, current, and timing every time
Welding robots cost less than robots designed for other tasks
